capabilities: fold and edit collapsible callout blocks in Live Preview
insert toggle headings at levels 1, 2, or 3
add anchored comment threads to selected text
read, reply to, edit, and delete individual comment replies
update a configurable note property via a Work status menu
disambiguation: Not a media or ebook editor; despite the name it only edits collapsible blocks and adds comment threads in Markdown notes.
extras: Manual installation from release files; desktop only (Obsidian 1.15.0+); interface labels are currently Chinese with bilingual settings; an optional legacy mode recognizes imported Notion footnote comments.
intentEvidence: Toggles are Markdown callouts. Comments are footnotes in the same Markdown file.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to attach reply threads to selected passages or extra controls for editing collapsible callout blocks.

relations.evidence: treat imported n1, n2, and similar footnotes as comments

summary: Markdown editor that folds collapsible callout blocks in place and adds anchored comment threads stored as footnotes in the same note.
